Lower Text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may return 1 level 3 Digimon to the hand.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If level 3 Digimon cards are in this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the hand. If such aren't, you may place 1 blue level 3 Digimon card from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
